examples.en: Rosamond Oliver kept her word in coming to visit me.
examples.zh: 罗莎蒙德·奥利弗守信来看我。

examples.en: Rosamond was full of glee and pleasure all the time I stayed.
examples.zh: 我呆在那里时罗莎蒙德一直非常高兴。

examples.en: Rosamond Oliver: The rather shallow and coquettish, but beautiful and good-natured daughter of Morton's richest man.
examples.zh: 奥利弗：较浅和风骚，但美丽善良的首富莫尔顿的女儿。
